Learn: Reading odds as probabilities
Decimal odds are a chance in disguise.

Divide 1 by the odds.
Odds 1.50 = 66.7%
Odds 1.91 = 52.4%
Odds 2.00 = 50%
Odds 3.00 = 33.3%

Market vs. model.
The odds are what the market thinks will happen.
Our cards show our chance next to the market chance, so you can see where we disagree and by how much.

Odds tell you what the market believes. The real question is whether it is right.
